related.title: Union–Find：連通分量與路徑壓縮
related.titleEn: Union–Find: connected components and path compression
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付topology.csv與cycle/blocked分類；時間是假設工期。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver topology.csv and cycle/blocked classifications; durations are assumptions. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 記parent、rank/size與root；每次union先find，將重複連邊標為no-op。
related.differenceEn: Record parent, rank/size and roots; find before union and mark repeated connectivity as a no-op.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
入度為零的節點才可從DAG移出；有剩餘節點代表循環或受循環阻擋，不代表剩下全部都在同一cycle。
本課數值核對：max(2,3)+4+1 = 8 s；另一項核對：2+3+4+1 = 10 s。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

disjoint-set追蹤等價類；union兩個已同根元素不減少分量數。路徑壓縮改樹形但不改連通關係。
本課數值核對：6-3 = 3 components；另一項核對：3-1 = 2 components。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Only zero-indegree nodes can be removed; residual nodes are cyclic or blocked by cycles, not necessarily all members of one cycle.
Numeric audit: max(2,3)+4+1 = 8 s; second audit: 2+3+4+1 = 10 s. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Disjoint sets track equivalence classes; union within an existing class does not reduce component count. Path compression changes shape, not connectivity.
Numeric audit: 6-3 = 3 components; second audit: 3-1 = 2 components. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Protocol Buffers：varint、tag 與欄位演化
related.titleEn: Protocol Buffers: varints, tags and schema evolution
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付topology.csv與cycle/blocked分類；時間是假設工期。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver topology.csv and cycle/blocked classifications; durations are assumptions. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 逐byte拆field number、wire type、length與payload，保持未知欄位可被有界跳過。
related.differenceEn: Decode field number, wire type, length and payload byte by byte, keeping unknown fields bounded when skipped.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
入度為零的節點才可從DAG移出；有剩餘節點代表循環或受循環阻擋，不代表剩下全部都在同一cycle。
本課數值核對：max(2,3)+4+1 = 8 s；另一項核對：2+3+4+1 = 10 s。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

tag包含field number與wire type；未知欄位可由相容parser跳過，但重新使用已刪欄號會破壞語意相容。
本課數值核對：2*8+2 = 18 tag；另一項核對：1+1+3 = 5 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Only zero-indegree nodes can be removed; residual nodes are cyclic or blocked by cycles, not necessarily all members of one cycle.
Numeric audit: max(2,3)+4+1 = 8 s; second audit: 2+3+4+1 = 10 s. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

A tag contains field number and wire type; compatible parsers can skip unknown fields, but reusing deleted numbers can break semantic compatibility.
Numeric audit: 2*8+2 = 18 tag; second audit: 1+1+3 = 5 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
